concept.title: Command Centre overview
concept.shortdesc: Command Centre is one place to run Desktop Machine Shop, 3dpandme, OpenV, OpenD and personal life admin. Agents do the work; you decide what goes out.

conbody.p: An always-on server takes in email, Odoo events, social comments, schedules and your own requests. Each one is sorted cheaply, given to the right role in the org chart (Customer Support, Catalogue & Pricing, the Personal Assistant and so on), and worked on by an agent. Anything that would leave the building, such as an email reply, a social post or a price change, comes back to you as a proposal to approve, unless you have told that business to let it run.

image.alt: The Command Centre Inbox on a PC: a sidebar of pages on the left, today's spend and counts at the top, and a list of tasks with their business, status and role.

section.title: What you do day to day

ul.li: Approve or adjust what the agents propose, in Approvals, or straight from a push notification.
Ask for things in Chat, or hands-free in Converse.
Keep an eye on work in the Inbox, and on your own day in Today.
Teach the agents by editing notes in the Brain and roles in the Org chart.

section.title: Getting help in the app
section.p: Press the ? button in the top bar, or F1, on any page. Help opens on the page you are on, and on the field, button or dialog you are using when it has its own help.

ol.li: Sign in, or set up the server.
Install the app on your phone and PC.
Connect your accounts: Claude (or ChatGPT) first, then email, Odoo, Google and social.
